doc_id: City of Medicine Hat - LMS tender

rfp_contact.value: Joanne Bruneau-Carter; joabru@medicinehat.ca. RFP communications must be initiated through the City's bids&tenders 'Submit a Question' function.

submission_method.value: Submit through the City of Medicine Hat online bidding system at medicinehat.bidsandtenders.ca; other submission methods are not accepted.

contract_term.value: 5-year base term plus annual extension options for an additional 2 years; maximum 7 years.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Provide a modern, secure corporate LMS for about 1,500 employees and other learners, supporting onboarding, compliance/safety training, professional development, certifications, content delivery/creation, assessments, analytics/reporting, integrations with Microsoft 365/Azure AD and City enterprise systems, implementation/migration, training and ongoing support.
scope_of_deliverables.note: Invitation and attached Scope of Work.

value: Completed and signed Submission Form (Appendix B).
Pricing information compliant with Appendix C.
mandatory_submission_requirements.note: Appendix D Section D explicitly lists these mandatory submission requirements. Other proposal-content items are requested/rated but are not in the formal mandatory-submission section.

value: Comply with the attached Functional Requirements / Scope of Work.
Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit.
Follow industry security best practices such as SOC 2 / ISO.
Address PIPA/public-sector privacy obligations and maintain an incident-response plan.
Maintain business continuity/disaster recovery and data-retention controls.
Integrate with City systems including Azure AD/Entra ID, Microsoft 365 and ERP/Unit4.
mandatory_technical_requirements.note: Appendix D Section E makes technical requirements mandatory by reference; this list contains the technical obligations visible in the PDF itself and does not invent requirements from the external Excel appendix.

evaluation_criteria.note: Stage 1 subtotal is 100 points; Stage 2 demo adds 30, for 130 total.

minimum_score_threshold.note: Minimum technical score is 35 out of 50 points (70%) in Stage 1. The numeric value remains 35 to preserve the benchmark field's number type.

pricing_structure.value: Use the Proposal Compensation/Pricing form. Prices in CAD, exclusive of GST; separate one-time implementation costs from annual recurring costs. Include licensing, implementation/configuration/migration/testing/go-live, security/integration, training/documentation, support/maintenance and five-year costs. Pricing is worth 15 points.

value.minimum: CAD 2,000,000 per occurrence; property-damage deductible <= CAD 2,500
CAD 2,000,000 per employee per accidental injury/death (or contingent employer's liability)
CAD 1,000,000 per claim; aggregate >= CAD 2,000,000; deductible <= CAD 25,000; 12-month maintenance period

insurance_requirements.note: Appendix D Pre-Conditions of Award, Certificate of Insurance.

vendor_experience_required.value: Relevant LMS experience, years providing the service, LMS implementations including municipal/government implementations, similar-scope references from the last 5 years, and resumes/roles for implementation and support teams. No explicit minimum years of vendor experience is stated.

references_required.note: Rated criteria require a minimum of 3 references similar in scope and size over the last 5 years.

value: Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit.
Industry security best practices / SOC 2 or ISO-type compliance.
data_security_requirements.note: Scope of Work and pre-condition cybersecurity assessment.

data_hosting_residency.value: Vendor server / hosting in Canada is preferred to support PIPA compliance; Canadian residency is stated as a preference, not an absolute mandatory requirement.

vendor_demonstration_required.note: Stage 2 is a scored product demonstration (30 points); up to six top-ranked proponents meeting the technical threshold may be invited.
